clauses.text:
Executive Order 5848. May 16, 1932
Executive Order
AMENDMENTS TO TARIFF OF UNITED STATES CONSULAR FEES
The Tariff of the United States Consular Fees is hereby amended as follows :
Item 8 is amended so as to provide that the fee for " Issue of passport " shall be
$9.00 , and the fee for " Renewal of an American passport " shall be $5.00 .
Item 24 is amended by deleting the words " Form No. 37. "
Item 25 is amended by deleting the words " Form No. 38. "
Item 26 is amended by deleting the words " Forın No. 39. "
Item 47 is amended to read as follows :

source.page_or_item: Hoover PEO vol. II (OFR 1974), printed pages 1137-1137, PDF pages 366-366

clauses.text:
47. For certifying to the correctness of copies of certificates of American origin,
manufacture , or inspection , where such services are performed upon written orders
of the Secretary of State for the purpose of advancing the export trade of the United
StatesNo fee .

ACT:EO:5848>EO:7968.producer_d6: Searched dossier chain/own_terms (none for the target), EDGES targeting the target (only EO 7968) and targeting EO 7968, and the held texts of the later orders that changed EO 7968. Later events on the ACTING order: EO 8297 (1939), EO 9303 and EO 9507 (each amends and revokes parts of 7968), EO 9407, EO 9521 (revokes 7968 "in part", effective on dates of superseding Secretary of State regulations), 9591, 9767, 10473 and EO 10697 Sec. 7 (1957-02-06, effective 1957-03-01, revokes 7968 "to the extent that they have not heretofore been revoked or superseded"). None of the held texts of these orders (8297, 9303, 9407, 9507, 9521, 9590, 9591, 9767, 10473, 10639, 10697, 10743) contains the target number, so none altered the supersession paragraph itself. EO 9521 contains the proviso that revocation of a listed order "shall not constitute a revival of any Executive order specifically revoked by any of the listed orders"; EO 7968 "supersedes" rather than "revokes" the target, so whether that proviso also bars revival is a legal question for the reviewer. No held text revives the target. Earlier end: none found; the target amends the Tariff of United States Consular Fees (items 8, 24, 25, 26, 47); the fee tariff was later restated by other orders (e.g. EO 9303/9507 amend section V-15 Tariff of Foreign Service Fees, held), but no instrument that names EO 5848 as ended is held other than EO 7968.
